title: Equality of polynomial space classes
statement: The class of languages decidable by deterministic finite Turing machines using at most a polynomial number of work-tape cells equals the class of languages decidable by nondeterministic finite Turing machines using at most a polynomial number of work-tape cells. In both classes, the polynomial bound has the form $c(n^d+1)$ for some natural numbers $c,d$, and the nondeterministic machines must halt within some finite number of steps on every branch for each input.
